summary: All 23 requirements implemented (9 Java files). No requirement unimplemented; 1 invented default, 1 ambiguity and 6 design choices recorded.

issues.title: No-reading distance is 1000.0 m
issues.raw: SR-DM5 asks for 'a large default value' when no reading is available but gives no number.
issues.fix_directive: If the requirements fix a value, replace NO_READING_DISTANCE in Sensor; any value well above OBSTACLE_THRESHOLD keeps obstacleDetected false on missing data.

issues.title: Negative or NaN IR readings are treated as 'no reading'
issues.raw: SR-DM5/SR-SF1 require distance() to be non-negative but do not say how an invalid measurement is handled. Sensor.update maps it to the no-reading default (the robot keeps moving) rather than clamping to 0 (which would trigger a turn).
issues.fix_directive: Change Sensor.update if invalid readings must instead be clamped or rejected.

issues.title: obstacleThreshold = 0.5 m is fractional and is rounded up in the model
issues.raw: The model's constants interface rounds fractional constants up, so the guard obstacleDetected (distance() <= obstacleThreshold) is checked in the model against 1, not 0.5. The Java keeps metres and 0.5 as SR-DM2 states; units were not rescaled.
issues.fix_directive: None in Java; read verification results for SR-GP1 with the rounded threshold in mind.

issues.title: Moving -> Turning: trigger event and guard both stated
issues.raw: SR-Beh2 fires the transition on the obstacle event; SR-GP1 says obstacleDetected is the guard of the same transition. Implemented as trigger Obstacle with condition obstacleDetected (both).
issues.fix_directive: Drop '&& obstacleDetected' if the event alone must trigger the transition.

issues.title: Power-up entry command issued in the constructor
issues.raw: SR-FR1 says Move(moveVel, 0) is issued on entering Moving; Moving is entered at power-up (SR-Beh1) without a transition, so the constructor issues it.
issues.fix_directive: None unless the power-up command should not be issued.

issues.title: Clock source and clock reset order
issues.raw: The current time comes from a Clock (monotonic System.nanoTime, seconds since creation); the controller field is named 'timer' because 'clock' is reserved. On Moving -> Turning, clockResetTime is set before Move(0, turnVel) is issued.

issues.title: Priority in Turning and ignored events
issues.raw: Turning: endTask first, then the autonomous turnDurationElapsed transition, then tick (conjoined with !turnDurationElapsed). Obstacle in Turning and every event in Final are ignored (no transition), as no requirement defines them.

issues.title: Sensor and Actuator are concrete classes
issues.raw: SR-ARCH2 calls them interfaces; they are final classes (the profile recognises sensor classes by name), each with one implementation.

next_step: Run the pipeline; no Java change is required by this review.
